Irrawaddy system.—20,000 feet. Upper series.—Yellow, friable sandstones with beds of brown clay. No fossil bones, fossil wood scarce. Lower series.—Yellow, friable sandstones and conglomerates. Much fossil wood and bones.
Pegu system. Yenangyaung series.—2,400 feet. Glauconitic sandstone and olive-green clays. Prome series.—3,100 feet. Petroliferous sandstones, blue clays, and coal-seams.
Bassein system.—1,200 feet. Sandstones and shales capped by Nummulitic limestones.
Chin system.—Over 10,000 feet of unfossiliferous shales and limestones.
